fields.issue: SiC and beryllium rank on compressive membrane modes only. SiC flexural strength (~380 MPa) and fracture toughness, and beryllium toxicity, joining and low ductility, are outside both formulas.
fields.effect: A high least-SF here is not a buildable face; bending, impact, attachment and thermal paths can govern.
fields.needed: A fracture/joining assessment before either is carried as a face material.
